notes.title: First patch!
notes.notes:
There's been a problem on some PC's where the player's kicks aren't being registered and I'm trying to investigate it. It does not seem tied to framerate or even specs, but I've reworked the code behind it so I'm hoping it works now.

Other changes:


 Insect projectiles disappear once that enemy is defeated
 Bug fixed where you could exit the sanctuaries if you had enough movespeed
 Some sound glitches fixed
